blocks.text: 201 15785 CROYDON DRIVE Grandview Surrey Surrey V3Z 2L6

parts.t: Stunning Condo with HUGE 1065 Sqft PATIO! This 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom unit in Morgan Crossing offers a generous 985 sqft of living space, complete with stylish laminate flooring in the living and dining areas. The spacious living room, featuring a cozy fireplace, is perfect for relaxation. The kitchen is a chef's delight with stainless steel appliances, modern cabinets, white quartz countertops, and a large center island, ideal for hosting and entertaining. Enjoy outdoor living and pet-friendly space on the huge balcony, perfect for summer BBQs. This unit includes two side-by-side parking spaces & a storage locker. Conveniently located just steps from a dog park, shopping centers, markets, restaurants, gyms! This pet-friendly building offers the ultimate in convenience and lifestyle.
